correctness.rationale: The published first-order Chebyshev stage recurrence specialized to common-curvature, same-component-per-outer-step gives exact affine X_next=rX+(1-r)b xi with r=T_s(omega0-omega1 t)/C, omega0=1+eps/s², C=T_s(omega0)>1. For even s and 0<t<2omega0/omega1, |r|<1, yielding unique W1-stationary Bernoulli series, mean zero and variance b²(1-r)/(1+r). Its two affine similarity images overlap/cover convex hull iff |r|>=1/2; otherwise two disjoint Cantor branches (or two points at r=0), with uniform law at |r|=1/2. Chebyshev zeros/extrema imply exactly s disconnected |T_s|<C/2 windows for C<=2 and one for C>2 (strict equality at C=2 separates). Minimum r=-1/C occurs at interior odd extrema, giving attained worst variance b²(C+1)/(C-1) and unique eps_s=s²(cosh(arcosh2/s)-1). Independently verified 48 exact-rational stages for s=2,4,6,8 and several eps/t; not an infinite-stage proof.
